'''Vet'ion's Rest''' is the lair of [[Vet'ion]], a skeletal [[Zamorak]]ian warrior.{{CiteNPC|npc=Andros Mai|quote=Vet'ion was a devout follower of the heretical god Zamorak.|loc=|notes=|name=}} It is a [[multi-combat]] [[dungeon]] located in the [[Wilderness]], just south of [[Lava Dragon Isle]]. Entering the boss lair requires completion of the [[Wilderness Diary#Medium|medium Wilderness diary]] '''OR''' a Vet'ion boss Slayer task, '''and''' pay a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. This fee is shared across [[Callisto's Den]], [[Hunter's End]], the [[Skeletal Tomb]], Vet'ion's Rest, the [[Silk Chasm]], the [[Web Chasm]] and the [[Escape Caves]]. The fee does not need to be paid again, unless the player dies to another player without having left the Wilderness since their most recent visit to a boss lair or the Escape Caves. If this happens, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer, and needs to be paid again to re-enter the boss lairs. Players can decrease the fee by killing the six bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins.
[[File:Wilderness bosses map.png|thumb|left|300px|The entrances to the boss lairs and the Escape Caves.]]
Like the [[Silk Chasm]] and [[Callisto's Den]], players exiting Vet'ion's Rest will always arrive at one of three points within the [[Escape Caves]] at random. Note that any player who exits within 10 seconds of the previous player will arrive at the same point, meaning [[player killers]] can pursue their targets through the boss lair.

Upon entering the lair, players will be unable to [[teleport]] for 3 [[ticks]]. This delay no longer occurs after completion of the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]].

In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills registered in their name.

You '''cannot''' set up a [[Dwarf multicannon|dwarven multicannon]] within the boss lair.

==Trivia==
* A [[Desecrated Tomb]] can be found within, which appears to be the source of Vet'ion's power.{{CiteNPC|npc=Andros Mai|quote=I stumbled upon an old tome which mentioned Vet'ion's final resting place, which I believe to be his source of power.|loc=|notes=|name=}}
* Vet'ion's Rest was first alluded to in [[Andros Mai]]'s dialogue in 2020, which he believed to be Vet'ion's source of power.
* Prior to this area's release, Vet'ion would roam the wilderness surface in a fixed area south of Lava Dragon Isle. Because he was in an open area, players would often lure the boss into safespots and kill him without having to deal with any of the boss's attacks or mechanics besides his [[Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion)|skeleton hellhounds]].
